item.title: 'The Muppet Show' returns for new adventures, featuring Sabrina Carpenter
item.description: If you watched "The Muppets" in decades past, you'd see such stars as Rita Moreno, Elton John and Liza Minnelli. Now, 50 year later, it's time to play the music and it's time to light the lights again!

item.title: Olivia Colman and John Lithgow star 'Jimpa,' new queer family drama
item.description: Three generations, one city and a whole lot of heart. Stars Olivia Colman and John Lithgow tell "important message" behind their new film, "Jimpa."

item.title: Judge orders arrest of man who put up fence, sign to block visitors at Daly City beach
item.description: Last month, Daly City police arrested him for allegedly threatening a couple, in which he said, "If you get near the fence I will shoot and kill you."

item.title: Levi's Stadium showcases new Super Bowl food, decor inspired by Bay Area
item.description: When Seattle Seahawks and New England Patriots fans roll into Levi's Stadium for the big game, they will experience a uniquely Bay Area culinary experience.

item.title: NFL athletes help students celebrate new sports field in East Palo Alto
item.description: NFL player Mekhi Blackmon of the Colts and brothers Rejzohn and Nahshon Wright of the Saints and Bears, all played on the field as kids and were at the celebration. "This is where I learned to be a teammate," Bears CB and East Palo Alto native Nahshon Wright said. "This is how I learned to be selfless."

item.title: Thousands of East Bay high school students walk out to protest ICE enforcement
item.description: Students chanted. They carried signs. Signs that read: "No ICE!" "No human is illegal." And, "Immigrants built this country."

item.title: 2 vehicles believed to be used in Stockton mass shooting seized, deputies say
item.description: Two cars believed to be used in the Stockton mass shooting last November have been seized by the San Joaquin County Sheriff's Office.

item.title: SFUSD facing dire fiscal situation amid looming teachers' strike
item.description: Laura Dudnick, SFUSD's spokesperson, said the district agreed to several changes despite facing a $100 million budget deficit for next year. The school district could lose millions of dollars a day if a strike is confirmed.

item.title: Supreme Court allows new California congressional districts that favor Democrats
item.description: The Supreme Court on Wednesday allowed California to use a new voter-approved congressional map that is favorable to Democrats in this year's elections, rejecting a last-ditch plea from state Republicans and the Trump administration.

item.title: San Francisco celebrates Girls and Women in Sports Day during Super Bowl week
item.description: The day is a time to recognize and reflect on female athletes and celebrate the trailblazers -- including some of the biggest names in sports.
